query_drafts.name: Process Registry Network Hunt
query_drafts.query:
// Hunt for Office spawning mshta, followed by persistence and network activity.
let process_window = 24h;
let suspicious_process = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(process_window)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("excel.exe", "winword.exe", "outlook.exe")
| where FileName =~ "mshta.exe"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine;
let persistence = DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(process_window)
| where RegistryKey has @"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueData, InitiatingProcessFileName;
let network = DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(process_window)
| where RemoteUrl != "" or RemoteIP != ""
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort;
suspicious_process
| join kind=leftouter persistence on DeviceName
| join kind=leftouter network on DeviceName
query_drafts.purpose: Draft query based on template query_templates\kql\process_registry_network_hunt.kql. Review field names before running.
